cards.title: Attempt on Conformal invariance of critical bond percolation on the square lattice
cards.body:
ATTEMPT RECORD, author-checked only, from the 2026-09-07 intake. Method: Look for a discrete holomorphic observable on the square lattice analogous to Smirnov's on the triangular lattice. Result: Smirnov's argument needs the three-arm colour-switching symmetry, which on the triangular lattice comes from site self-duality; on Z^2 bond percolation the dual is the shifted square lattice and the exploration interface lives on the medial lattice, where the parafermionic observable F(z) = E[e^{i sigma W(z)} 1_{z on interface}] with spin sigma = ... satisfies only half of the discrete Cauchy-Riemann relations (the contour-integral relations, as for FK models with q not 2). A concrete check: for the q=1 FK model the parafermionic observable has spin sigma = 2/3 and the relation sum over edges around a face vanishes, which gives crossing exponent bounds but not holomorphicity; the missing half is what conformal invariance needs. No new observable found. Obstruction: Only the weak (contour) half of discrete holomorphicity holds for the q=1 parafermion on the square lattice.
Refers to the open problem node open-problem-c0017-conformal-invariance-of-critical-bond-percolation-on-the-square-lattic
No independent review; result status attempted_unsolved

cards.title: Attempt on Convergence of random-cluster interfaces to SLE(kappa) for q in (0,4], q not 2
cards.body:
ATTEMPT RECORD, author-checked only, from the 2026-09-07 intake. Method: Check which ingredients of the q = 2 proof are available for other q. Result: The q = 2 proof uses (i) the parafermionic observable being discretely holomorphic (full Cauchy-Riemann), (ii) RSW-type crossing estimates for tightness, (iii) identification of the limit via the martingale observable. For q in (1,4) not 2: (ii) is available (Duminil-Copin-Sidoravicius-Tassion 2017 for q in [1,4]); (iii) would follow from (i); (i) fails: for general q the observable satisfies only the contour relations (half of the Cauchy-Riemann equations), the same obstruction as in C0017. So the conjecture is reduced, for q in [1,4], exactly to finding an additional discrete relation for the parafermionic observable; the count of unknowns versus equations (one complex relation per face versus two needed) is the precise deficit. For q < 1 even RSW is unavailable. No new relation found. Obstruction: Discrete holomorphicity is only half-satisfied for q not 2.
Refers to the open problem node open-problem-c0049-convergence-of-random-cluster-interfaces-to-sle-kappa-for-q-in-0-4-q-n
No independent review; result status attempted_unsolved

cards.title: Attempt on Cardy conformal invariance for Boolean continuum percolation
cards.body:
ATTEMPT RECORD from the Codex campaign (author-checked by that worker only). Method: Cardy conformal invariance for Boolean continuum percolation structural reduction or obstruction Result: Scaling space by1/r maps intensity1 centers with disk radius r to radius-one disks whose centers have intensity r^2. Therefore all Euclidean-scale behavior depends on the dimensionless product lambda*r^2 for general intensity lambda. Under a nonaffine conformal map, however, each disk is deformed and its local size depends on position. Check: An area A in scaled coordinates corresponds to original area r^2 A, yielding mean center count r^2 A. This proves the exact parameter equivalence. Obstruction: The scalar scaling relation does not control spatially inhomogeneous radii and noncircular images under conformal maps. Proving their irrelevance at criticality remains the obstruction.
Refers to the open problem node open-problem-p0129-cardy-conformal-invariance-for-boolean-continuum-percolation
No independent review

cards.title: Attempt on Cardy conformal invariance for Voronoi percolation
cards.body:
ATTEMPT RECORD from the Codex campaign (author-checked by that worker only). Method: Cardy conformal invariance for Voronoi percolation structural reduction or obstruction Result: A planar conformal map f sends a homogeneous Poisson process of intensity lambda to an inhomogeneous process whose intensity at w is lambda/|f'(f^(-1)(w))|^2. Thus exact rotation and translation symmetry of the original process do not produce exact invariance under arbitrary conformal maps. Check: The expected image count in a Borel set A equals lambda times the area of f^(-1)(A); the change-of-variables formula gives the stated Jacobian. Disjoint-set independence is preserved, so this identifies the transformed process. Obstruction: One would need to prove that a smoothly varying local intensity does not affect the limiting critical crossing law. The Jacobian computation exposes that missing universality step without proving it.
Refers to the open problem node open-problem-p0128-cardy-conformal-invariance-for-voronoi-percolation
No independent review

cards.title: Open problem: Conformal invariance of critical bond percolation on the square lattice
cards.body:
OPEN PROBLEM (source_says_open; current status no_resolution_found_in_documented_search; result status attempted_unsolved). Prove that critical bond percolation on Z^2 at p = 1/2 is conformally invariant in the scaling limit (Cardy's formula and convergence of interfaces to SLE(6)), as is known on the triangular lattice by Smirnov. Source: Garban and Steif: Noise sensitivity of Boolean functions and percolation, lecture notes with open problems, Chapter II Section 4, p. 26. Status notes: Bounded search 2026-09-07: no proof of conformal invariance on Z^2 found; the problem is listed as open in Duminil-Copin's ICM 2018 survey as well (dedup with that source).
Posed in Garban and Steif: Noise sensitivity of Boolean functions and percolation, lecture notes with open problems
Current status no_resolution_found_in_documented_search as of 2026-09-07
